summary: Star Holdings filed an 8-K disclosing amendments to its Safehold term loan and management agreements dated September 29, 2026. The Third Amendment extends term loan maturities one year to March 31, 2029, extendable to September 30, 2029, at a 1.0% higher rate plus a 0.5% extension fee, permits up to $50.0 million of prepayments, and creates a $10.0 million buyback basket contingent on repaying at least $40.0 million of margin loan debt. Star Holdings paid a $2.4 million extension fee; the term loan balance is $115.0 million with no incremental borrowings. The Termination Fee rises to $62.5 million. Watch margin-loan paydown and buyback capacity.
